definitions.meaning: Not having to pay a fine

quotations.old_english: Gelǽste ǽlc wuduwe ða heregeata binnan twelf mónðum, búton hire ǽr tó onhagige, wíteleás

source_text: wíte-leás; adj. Not having to pay a fine :-- Gelǽste ǽlc wuduwe ða heregeata binnan twelf mónðum, búton hire ǽr tó onhagige, wíteleás, L. C. S. 74; Th. i. 416, 18.
